## Summary

Natively 3.0.0 for Windows — adds Audio/Video Upload & Transcription, plus the latest dictation, overlay, and calendar fixes.

## What's New

- **Upload Audio:** transcribe an audio/video file (drag & drop) or a direct media URL via Deepgram Nova-3.
  - Speaker detection (diarization) toggle.
  - Language selector (Auto Detect + explicit languages, e.g. Vietnamese) to avoid mis-detection.
  - "Save transcript" toggle — default off: view + copy the transcript without saving it to My Natively.
- **Dictation:** system-wide hold-to-dictate, start from the TopPill logo, start/stop chime, toggle activation mode, and a text cleanup toggle.

## Improvements

- Refreshed TopPill quick settings and polished dictation states.
- Hide the model selector chip in the overlay footer.

## Fixes

- Calendar: keep the refresh token on transient failure and refresh proactively.
- Dictation: map the custom dictate shortcut to the correct physical key.
- Overlay: keep the TopPill parked/anchored correctly when Ask or dictation resizes it.

## ⚠️ Windows Installation (Unsigned Build)

When running the installer on Windows, you might see a "Windows protected your PC" warning from Microsoft Defender SmartScreen saying it prevented an unrecognized app from starting.

Since this is an unsigned build, this is expected. You can safely ignore it by clicking **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
